method: Cross-check common English names and ISO abbreviations against a separate geographic dataset. UN membership uses the 193 member codes (excluding observer Vatican City and Palestine); the reference currently flags Vatican City unMember=true, which is corrected here. Coastal set excludes ocean-landlocked members; Caspian-only coasts are checked separately under the clarified question scope.
observations: Jordan has a Red Sea coast and was missing.
Zambia must not be corrected to Gambia on new coastline questions.
